interests.title: Open Clusters
interests.subtitle: Formation, structure, and evolution
interests.description: My research focuses on the formation, structure, and evolution of open clusters in the Milky Way. By combining high-precision astrometry from Gaia with multi-wavelength observations, I investigate their stellar populations, spatial distributions, internal kinematics, and dynamical states. I am also interested in the role of stellar remnants in the dynamical evolution and mass composition of open clusters.

interests.title: Milky Way
interests.subtitle: Structure, kinematics, and evolution
interests.description: My research focuses on the three-dimensional structure, kinematics, and evolution of the Milky Way. This includes the structure and evolution of Galactic spiral arms, the spatial distribution and motions of different stellar populations, and the use of open clusters and other stellar tracers to explore the Galactic disk. I am particularly interested in using Gaia data to investigate the formation and evolution of the Milky Way's large-scale structures.

interests.title: Stellar Dynamics
interests.subtitle: Internal motions and dynamical evolution
interests.description: I investigate the internal kinematics and dynamical evolution of star clusters. In particular, I study their internal rotation, expansion, velocity dispersion, and dynamical states using precise stellar positions and motions. These properties provide important clues to understanding cluster formation, early evolution, and the role of dynamical processes in shaping their present-day structures.

interests.title: Star Formation
interests.subtitle: Young stars and interstellar medium
interests.description: I study the three-dimensional structure, kinematics, and evolution of star-forming regions in the Milky Way. By combining stellar data with multi-wavelength observations of the interstellar medium, I investigate the relationships between young stellar populations, molecular clouds, and surrounding gas structures. My research aims to understand the physical processes involved in star formation and the influence of stellar feedback on the surrounding environment.

experiences.title: Adaptive Mobile Manipulation for Cluttered Labs
experiences.summary: Building perception-driven manipulation policies that remain stable under shifting layouts and sparse demonstrations.
bullets: Combined language-conditioned task prompts with vision-based affordance maps.
Reduced reset time by introducing reusable evaluation scenes and scripted calibration checks.

experiences.title: Multi-Robot Inspection in Semi-Structured Environments
experiences.summary: Designed coordination logic for heterogeneous robots performing inspection rounds across changing indoor facilities.
bullets: Implemented map-sharing and fallback routing for intermittent connectivity.
Benchmarked task completion under degraded sensing and delayed communication.

experiences.title: Learning-Based Navigation Stack for Service Robots
experiences.summary: Explored hybrid navigation pipelines that blend classical planners with learned scene priors.
bullets: Added safety envelopes around low-confidence detections in crowded hallways.
Improved recovery behavior after localization loss through state-aware replanning.

interests.title: 疏散星团
interests.subtitle: 形成、结构与演化
interests.description: 我的研究主要关注银河系中疏散星团的形成、结构与演化。结合 Gaia 高精度天体测量数据和多波段观测，我研究疏散星团的恒星成员、空间分布、内部运动学及动力学状态。此外，我也关注恒星遗迹在疏散星团动力学演化和质量组成中的作用。

interests.title: 银河系
interests.subtitle: 结构、运动学与演化
interests.description: 我的研究关注银河系的三维结构、运动学特征及其演化过程，主要包括银河系旋臂的结构与演化、不同恒星族群的空间分布和运动特征，以及利用疏散星团等恒星示踪体研究银河系盘。我尤其关注利用 Gaia 数据探索银河系大尺度结构的形成与演化。

interests.title: 恒星动力学
interests.subtitle: 内部运动与动力学演化
interests.description: 我主要研究星团的内部运动学特征及其动力学演化，尤其关注星团的内部旋转、膨胀、速度弥散和动力学状态。通过精确的恒星位置和运动信息，可以进一步理解星团的形成、早期演化，以及不同动力学过程对其当前结构的影响。

interests.title: 恒星形成
interests.subtitle: 年轻恒星与星际介质
interests.description: 我的研究关注银河系恒星形成区的三维结构、运动学特征及其演化。通过结合恒星数据与星际介质的多波段观测，我研究年轻恒星族群、分子云及其周围气体结构之间的联系，进而探索恒星形成过程中的物理机制，以及恒星反馈对周围环境的影响。
